summary: A blue TSA PreCheck explainer animation moves through four illustrated panels: a laptop form, a boarding pass with circled PreCheck indicators, an airport sign directing travelers, and a traveler walking with luggage. The style is flat vector animation with white instructional captions at the bottom of each panel.
notable_text: TSA Pre✓; Add your Known Traveler Number when booking your airline ticket; Look for the TSA Pre✓ indicator; At the airport, follow the signs to the TSA Pre✓ security lanes for screening; Keep shoes, light jackets and belts on. Leave laptops and approved liquids in carry-on.
